2.t: These are the verses of the clear Book

3.t: Perhaps you ˹O Prophet˺ will grieve yourself to death over their disbelief
3.tr: La'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka allaa yakoonoo mu'mineen

4.t: If We willed, We could send down upon them a ˹compelling˺ sign from the heavens, leaving their necks bent in ˹utter˺ submission to it
4.tr: In nashaa nunazzil 'alaihim minas samaaa'i Aayatan fazallat a'naaquhum lahaa khaadi'een

5.t: Whatever new reminder comes to them from the Most Compassionate, they always turn away from it
5.tr: Wa-maa yaateehim min zikrim minar Rahmaani muhdasin illaa kaanoo 'anhu mu'rideen

6.t: They have certainly denied ˹the truth˺, so they will soon face the consequences of their ridicule
6.tr: Faqad kazzaboo fasa-yaateehim ambaaa'u maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

7.t: Have they failed to look at the earth, ˹to see˺ how many types of fine plants We have caused to grow in it
7.tr: Awa-lam yaraw ilal ardi kam ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem

8.t: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
8.tr: Inna fee zaalika la-Aayah; Wa-maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

9.t: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

10.t: ˹Remember˺ when your Lord called out to Moses, “Go to the wrongdoing people—
10.tr: Wa-iz naadaa Rabbuka Moosaaa ani' til qawmaz zaalimeen

11.t: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear ˹Allah˺?”

12.t: He replied, “My Lord! I fear that they will reject me
12.tr: Qaala Rabbi inneee akhaafu ai yukazziboon

13.t: And ˹so˺ my heart will be broken and my tongue will be tied. So send Aaron along ˹as a messenger˺
13.tr: Wa-yadeequ sadree Wa-laa yantaliqu lisaanee fa-arsil ilaa Haaroon

14.t: Also, they have a charge against me, so I fear they may kill me.”

15.t: Allah responded, “Certainly not! So go, both of you, with Our signs. We will be with you, listening
15.tr: Qaala kallaa fazhabaa bi-Aayaatinaaa innaa ma'akum mustami'oon

16.t: Go to Pharaoh and say, ‘We are messengers from the Lord of all worlds
16.tr: Faatiyaa Fir'awna faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolu Rabbil 'aalameen

17.t: ˹commanded to say:˺ ‘Let the Children of Israel go with us.’’”

18.t: Pharaoh protested, “Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you stayed several years of your life in our care
18.tr: Qaala alam nurabbika feenaa waleedanw Wa-labista feenaa min 'umurika sineen

19.t: Then you did what you did, being ˹utterly˺ ungrateful!”
19.tr: Wa-fa'alta fa'latakal latee fa'alta Wa-anta minal kaafireen

20.t: Moses replied, “I did it then, lacking guidance
20.tr: Qaala fa'altuhaaa izanw Wa-ana minad daaaleen

21.t: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and made me one of the messengers
21.tr: Fafarartu minkum lam-maa khiftukum fawahaba lee Rabbee hukmanw Wa-ja'alanee minal mursaleen

22.t: How can that be a ‘favour,’ of which you remind me, when ˹it was only because˺ you ˹have˺ enslaved the Children of Israel?”
22.tr: Wa-tilka ni'matun tamun-nuhaa 'alaiya an 'abbatta Baneee Israaa'eel

23.t: Pharaoh asked, “And what is ‘the Lord of all worlds’?”

24.t: Moses replied, “˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith.”
24.tr: Qaala Rabbus samaawaati wal-ardi Wa-maa bainahumaa in kuntum mooqineen

25.t: Pharaoh said to those around him, “Did you hear ˹what he said˺?”

26.t: Moses added, “˹He is˺ your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.”

27.t: Pharaoh said ˹mockingly˺, “Your messenger, who has been sent to you, must be insane.”
27.tr: Qaala inna Rasoolakumul lazee ursila ilaikum lamajnoon

28.t: Moses responded: “˹He is˺ the Lord of the east and west, and everything in between, if only you had any sense.”
28.tr: Qaala Rabbul mashriqi wal-maghribi Wa-maa baina-humaa in kuntum ta'qiloon

29.t: Pharaoh threatened, “If you take any other god besides me, I will certainly have you imprisoned.”
29.tr: Qaala la'init takhazta ilaahan ghairee la-aj'alannaka minal masjooneen

30.t: Moses responded, “Even if I bring you a clear proof?”

31.t: Pharaoh demanded, “Bring it then, if what you say is true.”
31.tr: Qaala faati biheee in kunta minas saadiqeen

32.t: So he threw down his staff and—behold!—it became a real snake

33.t: Then he drew his hand ˹out of his collar˺ and it was ˹shining˺ white for all to see
33.tr: Wa-naza'a yadahoo faizaa hiya baidaaa'u linnaa-zireen

34.t: Pharaoh said to the chiefs around him, “He is indeed a skilled magician
34.tr: Qaala lilmala-i hawlahooo inna haazaa lasaahirun 'aleem

35.t: who seeks to drive you from your land by his magic. So what do you propose?”
35.tr: Yureedu aien yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihee famaazaa taamuroon

36.t: They replied, “Let him and his brother wait and dispatch mobilizers to all cities
36.tr: Qaalooo arjih Wa-akhaahu wab'as fil madaaa'ini haashireen

37.t: to bring you every skilled magician.”

38.t: So the magicians were assembled at the set time on the appointed day

39.t: And the people were asked, “Will you join the gathering

40.t: so that we may follow the magicians if they prevail?”
40.tr: La'allanaa nattabi'us saharata in kaanoo humul ghaalibeen

41.t: When the magicians came, they asked Pharaoh, “Shall we have a ˹suitable˺ reward if we prevail?”
41.tr: Falammaa jaaa'as saharatu qaaloo li-Fir'awna a'inna lanaa la-ajjran in kunnaa nahnul ghaalibeen

42.t: He replied, “Yes, and you will then certainly be among those closest to me.”
42.tr: Qaala na'am Wa-innakum izal laminal muqarrabeen

43.t: Moses said to them, “Cast whatever you wish to cast.”
43.tr: Qaala lahum Moosaaa alqoo maaa antum mulqoon

44.t: So they cast down their ropes and staffs, saying, “By Pharaoh’s might, it is we who will surely prevail.”
44.tr: Fa-alqaw hibaalahum Wa-'isiyyahum Wa-qaaloo bi'izzati Fir'awna innaa lanahnul ghaaliboon

45.t: Then Moses threw down his staff, and—behold!—it devoured the objects of their illusion
45.tr: Fa-alqaa Moosaa 'asaahu fa-izaa hiya talqafu maa yaafikoon

46.t: So the magicians fell down, prostrating

47.t: They declared, “We ˹now˺ believe in the Lord of all worlds—

48.t: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.”

49.t: Pharaoh threatened, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission? He must be your master who taught you magic, but soon you will see. I will certainly cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, then crucify you all.”
49.tr: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aazana lakum innahoo lakabeerukumul lazee 'alla-makumus sihra falasawfa ta'lamoon; la-uqatti'anna aidiyakum Wa-arjulakum min khilaafinw Wa-la-usallibanna-kum ajma'een

50.t: They responded, “˹That would be˺ no harm! Surely to our Lord we will ˹all˺ return
50.tr: Qaaloo la daira innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa munqalliboon

51.t: We really hope that our Lord will forgive our sins, as we are the first to believe.”
51.tr: Innaa natma'u aien yaghfira lanaa Rabbunna khataa-yaanaaa an kunnaaa awwalal mu'mineen

52.t: And We inspired Moses, ˹saying,˺ “Leave with My servants at night, for you will surely be pursued.”
52.tr: Wa-awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa an asri bi'ibaadeee innakum muttaba'oon

53.t: Then Pharaoh sent mobilizers to all cities

54.t: ˹and said,˺ “These ˹outcasts˺ are just a handful of people

56.t: but we are all on the alert.”

57.t: So We lured the tyrants out of ˹their˺ gardens, springs

59.t: So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to the Children of Israel

60.t: And so they pursued them at sunrise

61.t: When the two groups came face to face, the companions of Moses cried out, “We are overtaken for sure.”
61.tr: Falammaa taraaa'al jam'aani qaala as-haabu Moosaaa innaa lamudrakoon

62.t: Moses reassured ˹them˺, “Absolutely not! My Lord is certainly with me—He will guide me.”
62.tr: Qaala kallaaa inna ma'iya Rabbee sa-yahdeen

63.t: So We inspired Moses: “Strike the sea with your staff,” and the sea was split, each part was like a huge mountain
63.tr: Fa-awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa anid rib bi'asaakal bahra fanfalaqa fakaana kullu firqin kattawdil 'azeem

64.t: We drew the pursuers to that place

65.t: and delivered Moses and those with him all together

67.t: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
67.tr: Inna fee zaalika la-Aayaah; Wa-maa kaana aksaru-hu mu'mineen

68.t: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

69.t: Relate to them ˹O Prophet˺ the story of Abraham

70.t: when he questioned his father and his people, “What is that you worship ˹besides Allah˺?”
70.tr: Iz qaala li-abeehi Wa-qawmihee maa ta'budoon

71.t: They replied, “We worship idols, to which we are fully devoted.”

72.t: Abraham asked, “Can they hear you when you call upon them

73.t: Or can they benefit or harm you?”

74.t: They replied, “No! But we found our forefathers doing the same.”
74.tr: Qaaloo bal wajadnaaa aabaaa-'anaa kazaalika yaf'aloon

75.t: Abraham responded, “Have you ˹really˺ considered what you have been worshipping—

77.t: They are ˹all˺ enemies to me, except the Lord of all worlds

78.t: ˹He is˺ the One Who created me, and He ˹alone˺ guides me

79.t: ˹He is˺ the One Who provides me with food and drink

80.t: And He ˹alone˺ heals me when I am sick

81.t: And He ˹is the One Who˺ will cause me to die, and then bring me back to life

82.t: And He is ˹the One˺ Who, I hope, will forgive my flaws on Judgment Day.”
82.tr: Wallazeee atma'u aien yaghfira lee khateee'-atee Yawmad Deen

83.t: “My Lord! Grant me wisdom, and join me with the righteous
83.tr: Rabbi hab lee hukmanw Wa-alhiqnee bis-saaliheen

84.t: Bless me with honourable mention among later generations
84.tr: Waj'al lee lisaana sidqin fil aakhireen

85.t: Make me one of those awarded the Garden of Bliss

86.t: Forgive my father, for he is certainly one of the misguided
86.tr: Waghfir li-abeee innahoo kaana mind daalleen

87.t: And do not disgrace me on the Day all will be resurrected—

88.t: the Day when neither wealth nor children will be of any benefit
88.tr: Yawma laa yanfa'u maalunw Wa-laa banoon

89.t: Only those who come before Allah with a pure heart ˹will be saved˺.”
89.tr: Illaa man atal laaha biqalbin saleem

90.t: ˹On that Day˺ Paradise will be brought near to the God-fearing

91.t: and the Hellfire will be displayed to the deviant

92.t: And it will be said to them, “Where are those you used to worship
92.tr: Wa-qeela lahum aina maa kuntum ta'budoon

93.t: besides Allah? Can they help you or even help themselves?”
93.tr: Min doonil laahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroon

94.t: Then the idols will be hurled headlong into Hell, along with the deviant

95.t: and the soldiers of Iblîs, all together

96.t: There the deviant will cry while disputing with their idols

97.tr: Tallaahi in kunnaa lafee dalaalim mubeen

98.t: when we made you equal to the Lord of all worlds

99.t: And none led us astray other than the wicked

100.t: Now we have none to intercede for us

102.t: If only we could have a second chance, then we would be believers.”
102.tr: Falaw anna lanaa karratan fanakoona minal mu'mineen

103.t: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
103.tr: Inna fee zaalika la-Aayatanw Wa-maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

104.t: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

105.t: The people of Noah rejected the messengers

106.t: when their brother Noah said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
106.tr: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Noohun alaa tattaqoon

107.t: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you

108.t: So fear Allah, and obey me

109.t: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds
109.tr: Wa-maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

110.t: So fear Allah, and obey me.”

111.t: They argued, “How can we believe in you, when you are followed ˹only˺ by the lowest of the low?”

112.t: He responded, “And what knowledge do I have of what they do

113.t: Their judgment is with my Lord, if you had any sense
113.tr: In hisaabuhum illaa 'alaa Rabbee law tash'uroon

114.t: I am not going to expel the believers

115.t: I am only sent with a clear warning.”

116.t: They threatened, “If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be stoned ˹to death˺.”
116.tr: Qaaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa-Noohu latakoonanna minal marjoomeen

117.t: Noah prayed, “My Lord! My people have truly rejected me

118.t: So judge between me and them decisively, and save me and the believers with me.”
118.tr: Faftab bainee Wa-bai-nahum fat-hanw Wa-najjinee Wa-mam ma'iya minal mu'mineen

119.t: So We saved him and those with him in the fully loaded Ark
119.tr: Fa-anjainaahu Wa-mam ma'ahoo fil fulkil mashhoon

120.t: Then afterwards We drowned the rest

121.t: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
121.tr: Inna fee zaalika la-Aayaah; Wa-maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

122.t: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

123.t: The people of ’Âd rejected the messengers

124.t: when their brother Hûd said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
124.tr: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Hoodun alaa tattaqoon

125.t: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you

126.t: So fear Allah, and obey me

127.t: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds
127.tr: Wa-maa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

128.t: ˹Why˺ do you build a landmark on every high place in vanity

129.t: and construct castles, as if you are going to live forever

130.t: and act so viciously when you attack ˹others˺

131.t: So fear Allah, and obey me

132.t: Fear the One Who has provided you with ˹the good˺ things you know

133.t: He provided you with cattle, and children

135.t: I truly fear for you the torment of a tremendous day.”

136.t: They responded, “It is all the same to us whether you warn ˹us˺ or not
136.tr: Qaaloo sawaaa'un 'alainaaa awa-'azta am lam takum minal waa'izeen

137.t: This is simply the tradition of our predecessors

138.t: And we will never be punished.”

139.t: So they rejected him, and ˹so˺ We destroyed them. Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
139.tr: Fakazzaboohu fa-ahlaknaahum; inna fee zaalika la-aayah; Wa-maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

140.t: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

141.t: The people of Thamûd rejected the messengers

142.t: when their brother Ṣâliḥ said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
142.tr: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Saalihun alaa tattaqoon

143.t: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you

144.t: So fear Allah, and obey me

145.t: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds
145.tr: Wa-maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

146.t: Do you think you will be ˹forever˺ left secure in what you have here

148.t: and ˹various˺ crops, and palm trees ˹loaded˺ with tender fruit

149.t: to carve homes in the mountains with great skill

150.t: So fear Allah, and obey me

151.t: And do not follow the command of the transgressors

152.t: who spread corruption throughout the land, never setting things right.”
152.tr: Allazeena yufsidoona fil ardi Wa-laa yuslihoon

154.t: You are only a human being like us, so bring forth a sign if what you say is true.”
154.tr: Maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa faati bi-Aayatin in kunta minas saadiqeen

155.t: Ṣâliḥ said, “Here is a camel. She will have her turn to drink as you have yours, each on an appointed day
155.tr: Qaala haazihee naaqatul lahaa shirbunw walakum shirbu yawmim ma'loom

156.t: And do not ever touch her with harm, or you will be overtaken by the torment of a tremendous day.”

157.t: But they killed her, becoming regretful

158.t: So the punishment overtook them. Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
158.tr: Fa-akhazahumul 'azaab; inna fee zaalika la-Aayah; Wa-maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

159.t: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

160.t: The people of Lot rejected the messengers

161.t: when their brother Lot said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
161.tr: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Lootun alaa tattaqoon

162.t: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you

163.t: So fear Allah, and obey me

164.t: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds
164.tr: Wa-maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

165.t: Why do you ˹men˺ lust after fellow men

166.t: leaving the wives that your Lord has created for you? In fact, you are a transgressing people.”
166.tr: Wa-tazaroona maa khalaqa lakum Rabbukum min azwaajikum; bal antum qawmun 'aadoon

167.t: They threatened, “If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be expelled.”
167.tr: Qaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa-Lootu latakoonanna minal mukhrajeen

168.t: Lot responded, “I am truly one of those who despise your ˹shameful˺ practice

169.t: My Lord! Save me and my family from ˹the consequences of˺ what they do.”

170.t: So We saved him and all of his family

171.t: except an old woman, who was one of the doomed

172.t: Then We utterly destroyed the rest

173.t: pouring upon them a rain ˹of brimstone˺. How evil was the rain of those who had been warned

174.t: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
174.tr: Inna fee zaalika la-Aayah; Wa-maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

175.t: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

176.t: The residents of the Forest rejected the messengers

177.t: when Shu’aib said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
177.tr: Iz qaala lahum Shu'aybun alaa tattaqoon

178.t: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you

179.t: So fear Allah, and obey me

180.t: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds
180.tr: Wa-maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

181.t: Give full measure, and cause no loss ˹to others˺
181.tr: Awful kaila Wa-laa takoonoo minal mukhsireen

183.t: and do not defraud people of their property. Nor go about spreading corruption in the land
183.tr: Wa-laa tabkhasun naasa ashyaaa-'ahum Wa-laa ta'saw fil ardi mufsideen

184.t: And fear the One Who created you and ˹all˺ earlier peoples.”

186.t: Also, you are only a human being like us, and we think you are indeed a liar
186.tr: Wa-maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa Wa-in nazunnuka laminal kaazibeen

187.t: So cause ˹deadly˺ pieces of the sky to fall upon us, if what you say is true.”
187.tr: Fa-asqit 'alainaa kisafam minas samaaa'i in kunta minas saadiqeen

188.t: Shu’aib responded, “My Lord knows best whatever you do.”

189.t: So they rejected him, and ˹so˺ were overtaken by the torment of the day of the ˹deadly˺ cloud. That was really a torment of a tremendous day
189.tr: Fakazzaboohu fa-akhazahum 'azaabu Yawmiz zullah; innahoo kaana 'azaaba Yawmin 'Azeem

190.t: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
190.tr: Inna fee zaalika la-Aayah; Wa-maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

191.t: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

192.t: This is certainly a revelation from the Lord of all worlds

193.t: which the trustworthy spirit ˹Gabriel˺ brought down

194.t: into your heart ˹O Prophet˺—so that you may be one of the warners—

196.t: And it has indeed been ˹foretold˺ in the Scriptures of those before

197.t: Was it not sufficient proof for the deniers that it has been recognized by the knowledgeable among the Children of Israel
197.tr: Awalam yakul lahum Aayatan ai ya'lamahoo 'ulamaaa'u Baneee Israaa'eel

198.t: Had We revealed it to a non-Arab

199.t: who would then recite it to the deniers ˹in fluent Arabic˺, still they would not have believed in it

200.t: This is how We allow denial ˹to steep˺ into the hearts of the wicked

201.t: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment
201.tr: Laa yu'minoona bihee hattaa yarawul 'azaabal aleem

202.t: which will take them by surprise when they least expect ˹it˺

203.t: Then they will cry, “Can we be allowed more time?”

204.t: Do they ˹really˺ seek to hasten Our torment

205.t: Imagine ˹O Prophet˺ if We allowed them enjoyment for years

206.t: then there came to them what they had been threatened with

207.t: would that enjoyment be of any benefit to them ˹at all˺

208.t: We have never destroyed a society without warners
208.tr: Wa-maaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa lahaa munziroon

209.t: to remind ˹them˺, for We would never wrong ˹anyone˺

210.t: It was not the devils who brought this ˹Quran˺ down

211.t: it is not for them ˹to do so˺, nor can they

212.t: for they are strictly barred from ˹even˺ overhearing ˹it˺

213.t: So do not ever call upon any other god besides Allah, or you will be one of the punished
213.tr: Falaa tad'u ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fatakoona minal mu'azzabeen

214.t: And warn ˹all, starting with˺ your closest relatives

215.t: and be gracious to the believers who follow you
215.tr: Wakhfid janaahaka limanit taba-'aka minal mu'mineen

216.t: But if they disobey you, say, “I am certainly free of what you do.”
216.tr: Fa-in asawka faqul innee bareee'um mimmmaa ta'maloon

217.t: Put your trust in the Almighty, Most Merciful

218.t: Who sees you when you rise ˹for prayer at night˺

219.t: as well as your movements ˹in prayer˺ along with ˹fellow˺ worshippers

220.t: He ˹alone˺ is indeed the All-Hearing, All-Knowing

221.t: Shall I inform you of whom the devils ˹actually˺ descend upon

222.t: They descend upon every sinful liar

223.t: who gives an ˹attentive˺ ear ˹to half-truths˺, mostly passing on sheer lies

224.t: As for poets, they are followed ˹merely˺ by deviants

225.t: Do you not see how they rant in every field
225.tr: Alam tara annahum fee kulli waadiny yaheemoon

226.t: only saying what they never do

227.t: Except those who believe, do good, remember Allah often, and ˹poetically˺ avenge ˹the believers˺ after being wrongfully slandered. The wrongdoers will come to know what ˹evil˺ end they will meet
227.tr: Illal lazeena aamanoo Wa-'amilus saalihaati Wa-zakarul laaha kaseeranw wantasaroo min ba'di maa zulimoo; Wa-saya'lamul lazeena zalamooo aiya munqalabiny yanqaliboon
